description: Game addon metadata for the Playground experience library. Each object in `games` publishes one card on the site. New fields added in v2: `tags`, `engine`, `resolution`, `hasAssets`, `entry`, `source`, `releaseYear`, `rating`.

schema.id: kebab-case unique identifier (used as DOM id / route slug)
schema.title: Display name shown on the card
schema.file: Entry HTML file relative to site root
schema.entry: Folder + file path if the game lives in a sub-directory
schema.image: Thumbnail / cover image (svg > png > webp preferred)
schema.category: Casual | Racing | Building | FPS | Rhythm | Sandbox | Puzzle
schema.accent: Card color: violet | orange | green | blue | red | pink | cyan | amber
schema.description: Short one-liner shown under the title
schema.engine: Rendering / game engine used (Canvas | Phaser | Three.js | WebGL | DOM)
schema.hasAssets: true if the game has a sibling asset folder
